description: Feeds a campaign from a market signal monitor, or stops it with monitorId null. Each day the campaign's daily additions take the companies the monitor delivered and write to one person at each: the person the monitor already found, a store's owner, or jobTitle searched at the company (required unless the monitor is about online stores or the campaign already has a job title). It spends nothing by itself: people are added, and charged, at the campaign's daily people limit. Only a workspace owner or admin can change it.
name: set_campaign_signal_monitor
title: Campanha alimentada por monitor
